title: Taiwanese American Foundation 台美協進會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Foundation (TAF) is a non-religious and apolitical 501(c)3 nonprofit organization dedicated to fostering personal growth and developing servant leaders in the Taiwanese American community. Originally founded as the Midwest Formosan Christian Fellowship (MFCF) in 1966, it focused on bringing families together and building community for first-generation Taiwanese Americans and their children. TAF operates an annual summer conference with programs for juniors, junior high, youth, and college students, as well as a Parents weekend program. Beyond its flagship conference, TAF maintains a Board of Directors, a growing alumni network, and hosts an annual New Year’s gala. The organization continues to build a stronger presence within the broader Asian American community while emphasizing appreciation of Taiwanese heritage and personal growth.
